text:
Leah K: RC promotion blocked — `ci/cache-worker` failing artifact cache populate step intermittently (3/4 runs). change window in 1h.
deploy-bot: Promotion held for run 2026-03-26T13:00Z. Failing checks: cache-populate. Logs: https://ci.internal/runs/45111
Vikram S: looking — errors are `EADDRINUSE` when the cache-worker starts, looks like port contention on the ephemeral runner. race introduced by a concurrent helper job that binds the same port.
Leah K: that would explain the 50/50 flake. options: 1) add a quick pin to use the last-good runner image with older helper config (fast), 2) bump cache-worker to random free port (safer but needs test run), 3) abort and wait for full investigation (delays cut).
Vikram S: short term I can patch CI to force the cache-worker to pick a random free port (tiny change) and re-run smoke. should be safe and quick to validate.
Leah K: go for the CI patch. prefer not to pin images unless necessary.
Vikram S: opened PR `ci: use ephemeral port for cache-worker to avoid EADDRINUSE` -> branch `rc/ephemeral-port-1700501234`. Triggering manual promote after merge.
CI_Bot: PR merged by Vikram S. Manual promote requested.
deploy-bot: Manual promote triggered by Vikram S. CI run id 45112 queued.
deploy-bot: CI run 45112 cache-populate: 2/2 passed. Promotion allowed. :white_check_mark:
Leah K: cutting RC. Release notes: "RC 2026.03.26 — temporary CI guard to avoid cache-worker port contention; follow-up ticket #6012 to harden runner configs." Will add to notes.
Vikram S: creating #6012 with root cause, repro script, and a proposal: allocate a port range per job or move helper to unix socket.
Oncall_SRE: I'll add an alert for cache-worker EADDRINUSE spikes and adjust runner cleanup TTL to reduce port reuse. Also increasing deploy-bot artifact fetch retries to 4 for next 24h.
Leah K: thanks — note for post-cut: if #6012 shows underlying orchestrator bug we'll schedule a targeted rollout next maintenance window. For now RC proceeds.
Vikram S: adding a small integration test to detect binding conflicts in the next nightly to catch regressions.
Leah K: promote complete. If canary or subsequent slices show cache misses, we revert the CI change and pin the runner image while we fix orchestrator.
CI_Bot: FYI — recorded manual promote and CI run ids (45112) in release metadata.
